expected_flux.source_equivalence: SPARTA vscale=sqrt(2*T), scosine=u/vscale gives the same J/n in mol_inflow; its target multiplies by nrho*A*dt/(fnum*cellweight). Actual geometry is 256x1x1 with unit transverse face area, one species, no cell weighting, region restriction, modulation or subsonic correction. Fixed inward drifts are above the SPARTA scosine<-3 cutoff.
expected_flux.primary_application: Each of two physical boundary faces, one HS species, independently at each Strang half-stream: Delta_t=dt/2, area=1, unchanged W/density/temperature/drift.

count_law.expectation: E[N]=mu exactly for fixed mu under ideal uniform draws.
count_law.variance: Var[N]=r*(1-r)<=1/4, versus Var[N_Poisson]=mu. This is random rounding, not a Poisson arrival process.
count_law.marked_flux: With unchanged independent flux-conditioned velocity marks and uniform within-half-step remaining flight time, expected injected number/momentum/energy equal mu times the corresponding incoming mark means. Outflow bookkeeping still records every actual crossing.
count_law.important_limit: Unbiased boundary estimators do not prove that a finite-W nonlinear collision simulation has an exactly unbiased continuum Boltzmann solution. Existing finite-weight, dx, dt, reference-error and stationarity checks remain necessary.

independent_reference_scope.observed: Actual saved SPARTA input uses separate emit/face up xlo and down xhi with default perspecies=yes/nevery=1. Its per-face per-full-step integer rounding is the same class of mean-preserving macro estimator, rather than Poisson.
independent_reference_scope.not_identical_stochastic_process: Two independent half-step rounded counts have full-step variance 2*frac(mu_full/2)*(1-frac(mu_full/2)); one SPARTA full-step rounded count has variance frac(mu_full)*(1-frac(mu_full)). They agree in mean, not generally in count variance or temporal noise. Do not describe the solvers as identical stochastic boundary processes.
independent_reference_scope.velocity_scope: Both target the incoming flux-weighted drifting Maxwellian and uniform arrival times. The inspected SPARTA rejection implementation has beta proposal in [-3,3] and an extreme backflow cutoff; the authored primary CDF has its own checked finite 12-sigma bracket. These are finite-tail implementations of the same reservoir model, not bit-identical unbounded samplers.
independent_reference_scope.independence: Independent SPARTA collision/transport/sampler implementation and independent seeds remain independent references even when a standard boundary estimator class is shared. Reference87 qualifiers remain empirical finite-grid evidence, not an exact Boltzmann error bound.

statistical_interpretation.centroid: diagnostics.centroid is an unaligned mass-excess position. Gate is abs(mean of per-seed late-minus-early centroid drift)+3*whole-seed SE, not maximum absolute shock displacement and not recentered profiles.
statistical_interpretation.uncertainty: Four independent whole runs remain replicate units; bins/particles/timeblocks are not promoted to independent replicates. Lower injection noise can reduce SE while retaining the same precision/equivalence criteria.
statistical_interpretation.limitations_ja: この版はBoltzmann平均場の教育用検証に限定する。Poisson到着数統計・熱揺らぎ・正しい粒子数分散やshock wanderingの揺動スペクトルの再現を主張してはならない。分散削減は平均流束を保つが、5つの失敗ゲートの合格は保証しない。固定seedでも乱数消費が変わり、その後の衝突履歴は同一ではない。
